text: 9月8日，国务院以“高质量推进城市更新、促进城市内涵式发展”为主题，进行第二十一次专题学习。国务院总理李强在主持学习时强调，要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于城市更新工作的重要指示精神和党中央有关决策部署，建立可持续的城市更新模式，促进城市结构优化、功能完善、文脉赓续、品质提升，以城市高质量发展更好满足人民美好生活需要。
text_en: On September 8, the State Council held its 21st special study session themed 'Advancing Urban Renewal with High Quality and Promoting Connotative Urban Development.' During the session, Premier Li Qiang emphasized the need to thoroughly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on urban renewal work and relevant Party Central Committee decisions, establish a sustainable urban renewal model, promote urban structure optimization, functional improvement, cultural heritage preservation, and quality enhancement, so as to better meet people's needs for a better life through high-quality urban development.
